name: docs-sync
description: Hook that, once per change set at Stop, nudges Claude with docs that mention a file this session edited or a name its edits removed. Skips plans, research, ADRs and changelogs; fails open. Needs git and bun.

enabled.title: Enable the nudge
enabled.description: Off: nothing is recorded and no docs nudge appears. Only an exact false turns it off.

maxDocs.title: Docs listed per nudge
maxDocs.description: Most docs the nudge lists, 1 to 50.

skipPaths.title: Extra paths to skip
skipPaths.description: Repo-relative path prefixes, separated by commas or spaces, that never count as docs to check, in addition to docs/plans, docs/research, docs/adr, .agents, .claude/plans and CHANGELOG files. An entry must start with a letter, digit or `_` and use only letters, digits, `_ . / -`; anything else, or an entry containing `..`, is ignored, so hidden folders such as .github cannot be listed.
